import os
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
from bioblend.galaxy.histories import HistoryClient
api_key = open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE'], 'r').read().strip()
gi = GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)
hc = HistoryClient(gi)
seed_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b59a30f648c46d2fac'
result = hc.copy_history(seed_id, name='Codex copy: Jackdaw filtered CpG density', all_datasets=True)
print('history_id='+result['id'])
print('history_name='+result.get('name',''))
print('state='+result.get('state',''))
PY"
